Rules:
- Translate the block as a coherent passage, not as isolated source lines.
- Do not manually insert @h or speaker names. The tool will wrap lines and create game windows automatically.
- Preserve character voice, narrative flow, and important pauses.
- ASCII apostrophes and contractions are allowed. Do not use curly quotes, em dashes, en dashes, or ellipsis characters.
- The English may be longer or shorter than the Japanese if that improves quality.

prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

prompt_parts.content:
Previous translated blocks in this scene:
{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0009",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 11,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02502-02503",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "ああ、今貰おう",
      "en": "Yeah, I'll eat now."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02505-02506",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "はいっ、では此方にお掛け下さい",
      "en": "Yes! Please, have a seat right here."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02508-02510",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "そう言ってシュリが案内したのは白いテーブルカバーが\n掛けられた他のテーブルとは明らかに違う、\nきちんと整えられた席だった。",
      "en": "Shuri led me to a seat. It was different\nfrom the other tables with white tablecloths.\nThis one was neatly arranged."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02512-02513",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "どうぞ",
      "en": "Please, sit."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02515-02517",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "シュリは先にテーブルまで行くと、\n椅子を引いて俺が来るのを待つ。\n……まあ、いつもの事か。",
      "en": "Shuri went ahead to the table, pulled out a chair, and waited for me. ... Well, this is nothing new."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02519-02520",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "御苦労",
      "en": "Thanks."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02522-02523",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "すぐに御用意いたします",
      "en": "I will prepare it right away."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02528-02529",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "努めて優雅な礼を一つすると、シュリは軽やかな足取りで\n厨房へと入っていった。",
      "en": "Shuri gave a graceful bow and then walked lightly into the kitchen."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02535-02536",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Haishera",
      "jp": "（目立つの……）",
      "en": "We stand out..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02538-02541",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "確かに店内にいる客達の奇異の視線が俺とシュリに\n向けられている。\nその客達の視線を遮るように俺の前に人が立った。",
      "en": "Indeed, the customers were staring at us curiously.\nThen someone stood before me, blocking their gaze."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02547-02548",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ふふっ、おかえりセリカ",
      "en": "Heh, welcome back, Celica."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02550-02551",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "すまないな、シュリが勝手な事を……",
      "en": "Sorry, Shuri got a little carried away..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02553-02556",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ぜーんぜん、寧ろ助かっているわよ、見なさいこの\n客の入り、みーんなこの店に可愛い娘が入ったって\n勘違いして来た助平共ばっかりなんだから",
      "en": "Not at all! You're actually helping me out.\nLook at the crowd - they're all just a bunch of\nlechers who heard there was a cute girl here."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02558-02559",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "大声で言うリンシャに回りの客達から笑いが起こる。\nどうやら、本当にシュリ目当てで来た客が殆どらしい……。",
      "en": "The customers around us laughed at Rinsha's joke.\nMost of them really came for Shuri, apparently..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02561-02562",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ほらねっ",
      "en": "See?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02564-02564",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "そう言ってリンシャが俺に向かって片目を閉じてみせる。",
      "en": "Saying that, Rinsha winked at me."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02566-02567",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "そうか、迷惑になってないのならいいんだが",
      "en": "I see. If it's not a bother, then that's fine."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02569-02571",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "勿論よ、こっちが悪いと思っているんだから……いいの？\nシュリちゃんを働かせちゃって",
      "en": "Of course! Honestly, I should be the one feeling sorry... Are you really okay with Shuri working here?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02573-02574",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "出来ればあの子の好きにさせてくれ",
      "en": "Let her do what she wants, if you can."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02576-02577",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ええ、そりゃあもう私としては大助かりだからいいけど",
      "en": "Well, she's a big help, so I don't mind."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02579-02580",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "頼む……所でシュリは何をしているんだ？",
      "en": "Thanks... By the way, what is Shuri doing?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02582-02582",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "シュリが厨房に消えてから結構な時間が経過している。",
      "en": "Shuri has been in the kitchen for quite some time."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02584-02586",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ああ、シュリちゃんだったら、セリカの食事を作るって\n張り切っていたわよ",
      "en": "Ah, Shuri? She was raring to cook your dinner."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02588-02598",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺が店に入った時に見せたシュリの表情の意味がやっと判った。\nシュリは幼い頃から俺の家で使用人として働いていた為か、\n家事全般を趣味としており、当然料理も出来るのだが、\nレウィニアの屋敷に居る時は料理は他の者の役目であり、\n旅の途中の野宿などではその腕を発揮できない。\n結局こういった特殊な状況でしか食事を作る機会が無い為、\n嬉しくて仕方がないのだろう……\nしかし、もし俺が他で食べて来たと言おうものなら、\nその落胆は火を見るより明らかだろう。",
      "en": "I finally understood the meaning of the expression Shuri showed when I entered the inn. Shuri has been working as a servant in my house since she was young, so housework is her hobby, and naturally she can cook as well. But when she is at the Lewinia mansion, cooking is the responsibility of others, and on the road during journeys and camping, she cannot show her skills. In the end, it is only in these special situations that she has a chance to cook, so she must be overjoyed... However, if I were to say I ate elsewhere, her disappointment would be as clear as day."
    }
  ]
}
